profile.headline: Software Engineer/ DevOps
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer / DevOps
positions.description:
Maintain/create  all deployment pipelines (Git actions, Java , yml, maven) for the team based on their requirements .
Configure blackduck, veracode,sonarqube reports for application code security.

Use software development skills to improve site performance and availability

Build automation for provisioning, configuration, and maintenance tasks using terraform for AWS cloud.

Familiar with ArgoCD deploy using helm files.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Build Deployment pipeline for Azure functions using YML, ps1 and Terraform.
• Built and deployed Docker containers to improve developer workflow.
• Following TDD, Using Event Sourcing (Azure service bus) approach for development.
• Participating in Agile activities such as Backlog grooming, Sprint planning, Retrospective
• Implemented Azure Alerting (Email and Teams) for failed Azure functions/notification.
• Set up Grafana monitoring board.
• Build APIs using c#.net, Entity Framework and SQL as backend.
• Automated tests (API and unit) using C#.net and Spec Flow

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer III
positions.description:
Project:
Xactimate Services
Responsibilities:
 Writing load testing scripts using Jmeter and integrated with AWS EC2
 Automate load testing in CI/CD pipeline using powershell and TeamCity
 Creating test plan, test scenarios in Jira
 Validated the REST APIs both Request and Response messages
 Testing and creating new Rest Based APIs in C#.Net
 Writing automation in C# and maintaining Test Automation to 100%
 Participating in Agile activities such as Backlog grooming, Sprint planning, Retrospective
Environment: TeamCity, C#.NET, Oracle, REST APIs, GitHub, Jira, Jmeter, AWS EC2

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Project:
Workforce Optimization (R&D Department)
Responsibilities:
 Developing automation and Unit Tests using C#.Net
 Maintaining and writing new Test Cases in Test Manager
 Working with Development and Product team in Agile based Environment
 Creating new Rest Based APIs in C#.Net
Environment: Team Foundation Server, C#.NET, SQL Server, Test Manager, REST APIs

positions.title: Quality Analyst
positions.description:
Salespider.com Business Social Network – Sales Spider is North America’s #1 business social network
for Small and Medium Sized Businesses (SMBs). Sales Spider has approximately 500,000 members.
Responsibilities:
 Developing test cases and scripts using Selenium Webdriver for Functionality, Regression and
GUI Testing of Salespider
 Contribute to the System, Functional, Regression and Integration Testing activities
 Providing testing reports for automation execution to client
 Writing Webdriver automation script using Java and JUnit Testing framework
Environment: Windows 7, PHP,mySQL, Toad for mySQL, Jira, Java, JUnit, Eclipse

positions.title: Quality Analyst
positions.description:
Project:
The Stock Research Portal is free Stock Market Research Tools for Canadian Mining and Oil Companies. Access company data on oil, gas, gold, silver, uranium, copper, base metals, oil sands, and more.
Responsibilities:
 Reviewed Test Plan for billing Project
 Extensively worked on database testing using Query Analyzer
 Created and executed the test cases according to the test cycles and logged all the defects with
their priorities in Quality Center
 Reported and managed defects using Quality Center
 Escalated “Show Stopper Defects” to the project resources
 Created Acceptance Criteria and generated test cases for UAT
Environment: ASP.NET, C#.NET, SQL Server 2005, Query Analyzer, Quality Center
